why: Pairwise direction errors are not the only uncertainty. Opponent strength may vary over a sparse graph. Shrinkage changes confidence in low-degree records but ignores whom each candidate faced. Add one opponent-adjusted estimator before new outcome inspection.
method: Colley (2002) solve (2 I + graph Laplacian) r = 1 + (weighted wins - weighted losses)/2. Ranks near maxima within 1e-12, break ties by larger number of positive-weight opponents then retain all exact count ties. Priors equal, no fitting or tuning. https://www.colleyrankings.com/matrate.pdf
factor_design: Rows hard (.7 or above unit weight) and linear soft w=max(2c-1,0) for parsed c in [0,1] and valid raw winner. Columns unadjusted shrinkage (1+sum weighted wins)/(2+weighted degree) and adjusted Colley. Main contrast hard adjusted minus hard shrink expressed as gain shrink regret minus adjusted regret. Soft-vs-hard in each column, interaction and legacy hard/win fraction as controls. True ties handled by evaluator, preserve original identity and raw judge order.
population: all original 850 jobs across DS plus all three fixed GPT banks. Primary schedule coverage_random. Sensitivity random_pairs and observed C0 unique edges on DS. All work is isolated diagnostic rule version, C0 current execution unmodified.
validation: Record predictions prior to joining labels; reconstruct historical DS selection; verify per task, paired task bootstrap 10000 seed 20261108093, leave each task out and pooled three banks within each task. Positive improvement gains defined baseline minus alternative. Apply parent advancement conditions for a single modification. A design crossing two changes alone can only advance after individual factor ablation. compare competing passing arms on common jobs, cheapest first when direct differences ambiguous. Tables cost same reads across arms, C0 fixed graph comparison controls for actual cost. Report all arms incl weak.
budget: one full evaluation per registered bank and schedule; no paid calls, training, or GPU; 600 seconds per invocation. Working margin .01; all prior results known except current registered experiments. No post-result parameter search.
